The video opens with a shot of a display case full of brightly decorated doughnuts, overlaid with the text "THE DENVER DOUGHNUT DASH!" in large, bold font. The scene then cuts to a close-up of a person securing the strap of a cycling shoe. A woman is then seen sitting on the floor of a garage attaching something to her shoe. She then stands up and pulls on cycling gloves. Her gray mechanic's shirt has "Candy" embroidered in red on one pocket and a patch that reads "WALNUT CAFE BOULDER CO" in red and white on the other. The person asking the camera, "Who's Candy?" to which Candy replies, "Who is Candy?" then lifting her shirt slightly and smiling, explaining "Candy is your favorite girl!" The woman is also wearing sunglasses and a yellow bicycle helmet with a floral design. The camera then shifts to a low-angle shot of a paved path cutting through a green landscape on a sunny day. The background includes a view of distant buildings.

The video segment features two cyclists on a paved path under a clear blue sky, surrounded by lush greenery and distant buildings, including mountains in the background. Initially, two cyclists are seen riding away from the camera along the path. The camera then shifts to a cyclist wearing a yellow, floral helmet and a face covering, riding alongside a grassy field. The viewpoint switches to a first-person perspective, showing the handlebars and the path ahead as another cyclist rides in front. Close-up shots capture the details of one bike's wheels, water bottles, and the cyclist's legs in black and argyle shorts, along with their blue socks and black shoes. The camera then focuses on the face of the cyclist in a red helmet, wearing sunglasses and a patterned scarf, as they speak directly to the camera. The video includes text that reads "31 MILES TO DOUGHNUTS", and later, "THE BIKEWAY IS 18 MILES SOUTH BOULDER - WESTMINSTER". The camera follows cyclists entering a tunnel before returning to an above-the-wheel view of them cycling, as they talk about the ride from Boulder to Denver.

The video features two cyclists riding along a trail with scenic mountain views. The video starts with a close-up of a bright orange poppy flower with a metal bridge and a cyclist in the background. As the video progresses, the cyclists, one wearing a green shirt and red-accented helmet and the other wearing a gray sleeveless top and yellow helmet, pass a herd of cows and greet them with a "Good morning." The camera angle shifts between close-ups of the cyclists and wider shots showing their journey down a dirt road, lined with green grass and shrubs. The cyclists' journey takes them past a red barn and a lush green field with the backdrop of rocky mountains under a clear blue sky. Near a fence, there are fields with thorny thistles and lavender blue flax flowers. The woman with the yellow helmet faces the camera and mentions they were supposed to be in the UK but are happy with their current location. Her helmet has "KRD LIVE LOVE" printed on it along the top edge and "nutcase" in lowercase on the sides. The last frame shows the helmet with the clear mountain background.

The video shows two people biking towards the Voodoo Doughnut shop in Denver. At the beginning of the segment, the biker wears a donut-themed sock, followed by a shot of the biker shifting gears on the bike. Then, the video shows the man in a red helmet and the woman in a yellow flowered helmet biking together, crossing train tracks, and riding alongside murals, under bridges, and past cityscapes. The drone shots show the cityscape, a stadium, highway traffic, and the train traveling along its track. The pair stops on the sidewalk in front of Voodoo Doughnut and the man asks the woman how many doughnuts she intends to eat. The woman says they are large, and she will start with three. The man explains that Voodoo Doughnuts are originally from Portland, Oregon, and Denver opened a shop a few years ago and adds that it is their once-a-year tradition to come down here.
